record.text:
I had to get a clip of the live-action Moana for my next video, so I watched the How Far I’ll Go scene and…yeah…

No offense to this new actress, she’s talented, but she is NOT Auliʻi Cravalho.

Disney's latest live action remake is flopping around like a fish out-of-water. Moana has a big hill to climb to be profitable. Upon further analysis, this comes off as strictly a cash grab with very little flash and fanfare put into it. Disney really disneyed too soon with a live action version.

Almost didn’t go see Moana because of the reviews but it was great! Putting aside that any remake is a cash grab, it was awesome to see this story in live action with an incredible Polynesian cast. And it was visually gorgeous. Getting excited for my sojourn in the South Seas next month.
